name: nf_tools_columns
description: Per-column analyzer assignments for the nf-tools SearchIndex (syn75081636, source syn51730943). Roles: IDENTIFIER for id-like fields (punctuation preserved, no stemming); nf_scientific_synonyms for free-text scientific/discovery fields; KEYWORD only for internal quality flags with no free-text search role. Anything a user might type as natural language is deliberately NOT KEYWORD and falls through to the defaultAnalyzer (STANDARD), because KEYWORD is exact and case-sensitive: resourceType/cellLineCategory for that reason on 2026-07-07, and sex/race/age on 2026-09-09 after lowercase 'black' and 'female' were measured at 0 hits against capitalised values (#23). age is a DOUBLE, so no text analyzer applies. geneticDisorder and manifestation are the unified columns the 2026-08 table revision moved to, replacing diseaseType and the cellLine*/animalModel* variants (#22). NOTE: description is capped near 1000 chars server-side; longer is rejected as a bogus name-collision error.
